text:
I turn the corner of prayer and burn

in a blessing of sudden sun

in the name of the condemned

I would turn back or run

to the hidden earth

but the sounding sun

purifies

the sky

Someone

finds me

Oh let him

scorch and drown me

inside his earthly wound

His lightning answers my cry

my voice burns in his hand

now I am lost in the One who blinds

and at the end of prayer the sun's clamor is heard.

translation.title: Prayer
translation.editorial_note: The translation follows the Spanish catalog text into a compressed, prophetic English prayer.
